select c.id, c.started_at, c.disappeared, c.notes_json->>'ended_paid_out_unstamped' as unstamped,
 (select count(*) from incentive_programs p where p.superseded_at is null and p.last_seen_at = c.started_at) as stamped_at_cycle,
 (select count(distinct program_id) from incentive_programs p where p.first_seen_at <= now() and p.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' and (p.end_date is null or p.end_date >= now() - interval '24 hours')) as limm_v2_24h,
 (select count(*) from incentive_programs p where p.superseded_at is null and p.disappeared_at is not null and p.status_observed = 'paid_out' and p.disappeared_at >= timestamptz '2026-10-11 22:15:00+00') as paidout_disappeared_since_deploy
from incentive_discovery_cycles c where c.started_at >= timestamptz '2026-10-11 22:15:00+00' order by c.started_at desc
